Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly stated that Greyhound Canada ceased operations in 2018, conflating the 2018 withdrawal from Western Canada with a full shutdown. Greyhound continued operating in Ontario/Quebec (and some cross-border routes) until discontinuing all remaining Canadian services in May 2021. This factual error misdirected subsequent steps toward concluding there were no Greyhound departures in Toronto, rather than identifying the historical departure point (Toronto Coach Terminal, 610 Bay Street) in the HQ city (Toronto).
